Named after a legendary [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Zahtjav (monster)|monster]] by the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Venslas Beeli]], the '''''Zahtjav''''' was a [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] produced by the [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]]. The [[Corvette/Legends|ship]] was owned by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and used as an [[Scout/Legends|exploration]] [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] until Beeli acquired it sometime after [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], making it a part of his [[Solar Terrors]] pirate band. Beeli and his pirates used it until shortly after [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], when an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Task force/Legends|task force]] [[Capture of the Solar Terrors|captured]] them. Imperial [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Vocis Kenit]] forced Beeli and his pirates into a [[Battle of the Solar Terrors|confrontation]] with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[Privateer/Legends|privateer]] [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] ''[[Far Orbit]]''; the ''Zahtjav'' was destroyed in the [[Space warfare/Legends|battle]], and Beeli [[Death/Legends|killed]].

==Description==
The ''Zahtjav'' was a [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] produced by the [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]]. Measuring 150 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] long, the [[Corvette/Legends|corvette]] possessed a Class 2 primary [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]], with a Class 12 as backup. The ''Zahtjav'' also had [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]], a [[Navigation computer/Legends|navigation computer]], and a set of [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]]. Capable of carrying 3,000 [[Metric ton/Legends|metric tons]] of cargo as well as enough consumables to last the crew a [[Standard year/Legends|year]], the ''Zahtjav'' could carry up to twenty passengers, in addition to its crew of fifty and its twelve [[Gunner/Legends|gunners]]; the [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] was capable of running on a skeleton crew of twenty, with five gunners, if necessary. The corvette also had an armament of four double [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] [[Cannon/Legends|cannons]], with a pair of [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beams]] situated at the front of the starship. Possessing [[Life support/Legends|life support]] systems, the corvette could reach a maximum speed of 950 [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] per [[Standard hour/Legends|hour]] in the [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] of some [[Planet/Legends|planets]].<ref name="Orbit" />

==History==
The ship that would later be known as the ''Zahtjav'' started out as an [[Scout/Legends|exploration]] vessel used for scouting the distant parts of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="Orbit" /> In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the Republic was [[Declaration of a New Order|reorganized]] into the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]],<ref name="NEW">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> and with its [[New Order/Legends|creation]], the corvette was sold as surplus due to budget cutbacks, becoming a secure cargo vessel. The CR90 served well, until an [[Unidentified engineer|engineer]] was bribed by the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Venslas Beeli]] of the raiding band known as the [[Solar Terrors]] to cut the hyperdrive at a designated point. Right after Beeli acquired the ship, he reneged on his payment of the [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]], instead setting the individual adrift in an [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]]. Sometime afterward, Beeli named the corvette the ''Zahtjav'', after a legendary [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Zahtjav (monster)|monster]]. The ship later became Beeli's [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]].<ref name="Orbit" />

[[File:ZahtjavVsFarOrbit-TheFarOrbitProject.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The ''Zahtjav'' and Beeli's other ships engage the ''Far Orbit''.]]
Beeli's activities in the Outer Rim soon brought him to Imperial attention<ref name="Orbit" /> around [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].<ref name="Date" /> After a three-[[Standard month/Legends|month]] hunt, [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Lev Kepzen]] and his [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]], the [[Feral (EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate)|''Feral'']], [[Capture of the Solar Terrors|captured]] the Solar Terrors.<ref name="Orbit" /> Captain [[Vocis Kenit]] forced the pirates to do the Imperials' bidding on pain of [[Death/Legends|death]], and they were tasked with posing as [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[Privateer/Legends|privateers]] and committing terrible acts in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]' [[Ringali Shell]] under that banner to sway the public's view of Alliance privateers. The poisoning of the public's opinion was in preparation for when the ''[[Far Orbit]]'', an Alliance privateer [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] operating nearby, announced itself to the general public. The Imperials wanted the ''Far Orbit'' captured, so they hoped the frigate would track the pirates down and engage them in order to maintain its reputation.<ref name="Rival">{{WEGCite|story=The Rival|book=The Far Orbit Project}}</ref>

However, in order to prevent the pirates from simply running off, they were all infected with [[Vira606]], an incurable virus that could only be held at bay by a [[Serum (Vira606)|serum]] that the Imperials controlled and rationed out to them. The ''Zahtjav'' and the Solar Terrors began to attack civilian targets near the worlds of [[Esseles/Legends|Esseles]], [[Rhinnal/Legends|Rhinnal]], and [[Brentaal IV/Legends|Brentaal IV]]. While they secretly worked for the Imperials, Beeli's [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]], including his [[Command ship/Legends|command ship]], the ''Zahtjav'', operated from a deep [[Realspace/Legends|space]] location with Kenit's escort frigate, the [[Stalwart (EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate)|''Stalwart'']].<ref name="Rival" />

{{RPGseed}}
With the Solar Terrors frequently hitting the area around Brentaal, Beeli's fleet [[Battle of the Solar Terrors|encountered]] the ''Far Orbit'', which was searching for the pirates in order to destroy them. The ''Zahtjav'' and Beeli's other ships, the ''[[Javiq]]'' and the ''[[Pyesmev]]'', [[Space warfare/Legends|engaged]] the frigate, with all of them trying to stay out of the way of the ''Far Orbit''{{'s}} forward fire arc. However, since Beeli fought with abandon due to the illness, the Solar Terrors lost the battle, and the ''Zahtjav'' was destroyed, with Beeli dying as well.<ref name="Rival" />
{{Endgame}}

==Commanders and crew==
After being acquired by the Solar Terrors, the command of the ''Zahtjav'' fell to Venslas Beeli, who used it as his flagship.<ref name="Orbit" />

{{RPGseed}}
However, it was Beeli who caused the ship's demise, as he fought with abandon due to Vira606 when the pirate fleet engaged the ''Far Orbit''.<ref name="Rival" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Zahtjav'' was first mentioned in [[1998]]'s ''[[The Far Orbit Project]]'', by [[Timothy S. O'Brien]], and appeared in the adventure scenario ''[[The Rival]]'', published in the book. ''The Far Orbit Project'' was a supplement to [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' and had the same theme of the previous publication, ''[[Pirates & Privateers]]'', as it followed the privateering vessel ''Far Orbit''. As the book says that Venslas Beeli fights with abandon and will ram the ''Far Orbit'' with his ship if necessary, this article assumes that the ''Zahtjav'' was destroyed in the battle.

There are also several different ways that the battle against the ''Far Orbit'' can be played out. One way is to have the ''Far Orbit'' encounter Beeli's ships and the ''Stalwart'' in deep space. Another is that the pirates are captured by the frigate while Imperials are nearby, forcing the EF76 to pretend that it is an Imperial vessel. However, this article does not use either of those options, and assumes the course of events that are presented in this article, because it offers the fewest inconsistencies in the frigate's story.
